id: \bGold: My name is Gold. I have the ability to draw out the largest potential of a baby Pokémon.
en: \bGold: My name is Gold. I have the ability to draw out the largest potential of a baby Pokémon.
it: \bGold: Mi chiamo Gold. Ho la capacità di tirare fuori il massimo potenziale dei Pokémon neonati.

id: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Hatcher.
en: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Hatcher.
it: \bPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Schiuditore.

id: \bGold: Have you ever tried Lava Cookies? I would suggest them to anyone traveling to Hoenn.
en: \bGold: Have you ever tried Lava Cookies? I would suggest them to anyone traveling to Hoenn.
it: \bGold: Hai mai provato i Lavottini? Li consiglierei a chiunque viaggi a Hoenn.
